messages:
aj: Quick proposal — can we add ageing buckets to the GPU healthscore and a dedicated Grafana row that compares per-region 'SLO burn' for GPU reliability? Current healthscore flips on single Xid bursts and it skews autoscaling decisions.

maria: +1, saw a case in eu-central where one noisy card caused a whole node pool to drain. Ageing buckets would help differentiate one-off vs trending. :thinking_face:

sachin: Agree. We should define buckets: 0-24h (transient), 1-7d (flaky), 7-30d (degrading), >30d (chronic). Then weight alerts differently.

liz: Also propose we surface a "recent-burst" panel (1h) vs "trend" panel (7d) so SREs can decide drain vs watch.

aj: Rough sketch of the scoring math I sketched in whiteboard:
```
# pseudo-promql/pseudocode for per-card health
ecc_norm = min(sum(rate(gpu_ecc_corrected_total[6h])) / 500.0, 1.0)
xid_norm = min(sum(rate(gpu_xid_errors_total[6h])) / 50.0, 1.0)
resets_norm = min(increase(gpu_reset_events[24h]) / 2.0, 1.0)
flaky_norm = moving_avg(gpu_eviction_count[7d]) / 3.0  # rough
health_score = 1.0 - (0.5 * xid_norm + 0.35 * ecc_norm + 0.15 * resets_norm)
# score in [0,1], lower is worse
```

aj: Alerts I propose: `GPU-card-degrade-warning` when health_score < 0.6 for >1h, `GPU-card-critical` when health_score < 0.4 for >15m.

maria: For Grafana panels I want: per-card sparkline, region rollup (p95/p99 of health_score), ageing-bucket distribution pie, and an SLO burn chart. Link to proto: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/gpu-health (mock).

sachin: PromQL for region aggregation (example):
```
sum by(region) ( (1 - (0.5 * xid_norm + 0.35 * ecc_norm + 0.15 * resets_norm)) )
/ count by(region) (gpu_card_info)
```

liz: We also need alert routing: warn -> infra channel, critical -> page oncall + create transient incident with tags {region,gpu_model}.

infra-bot: Noted. I can create the two alert rules in prometheus and tie to the alertmanager route `gpu-degrade` if you confirm thresholds.

aj: Confirming thresholds above. Also want a per-region SLO: 99.95% of assigned GPU-minutes in a calendar month should have health_score >= 0.6. Error budget burn tracked weekly.

maria: 99.95% feels tight for some APAC regions with limited spare capacity; maybe 99.9% for smaller regions and 99.95% for core regions (us-west1, eu-central1). We should have per-region SLO tiers.

sachin: Good call — implement SLO tiers by region class: core vs satellite. SLO targets and error budgets stored in metadata so console can show burn.

liz: Runbook additions: add a 'watch vs drain' decision tree. Quick heuristic: if trend bucket (7d) > 0.4 health drop or reset_count > 3 in 24h -> drain. If single 10x Xid spike in 1h and then back to normal -> watch.

aj: I'll PR the dashboard JSON and Prometheus rules later today. Can someone take the runbook and oncall policy? @oncall-jordan?

oncall-jordan: I can take the runbook update. Will also add routing to our pager policy to include `gpu-degrade` alerts.

maria: One more ask — add a cheap panel showing replacement cost estimate if we decide to replace card: `replace_rate * avg_card_cost` so PM can see cost impact.

aj: Good idea. For immediate action items: 1) aj -> PR dashboard + rules, 2) oncall-jordan -> runbook + pager routing, 3) liz -> implement ageing buckets in the scoring lib, 4) sachin -> create SLO configs per-region.

liz: I'll start a branch `feat/gpu-ageing-buckets` and push the scoring code and unit tests.

infra-bot: Created task: INFRA-7862 "GPU ageing buckets + Grafana row" and assigned to aj, liz, oncall-jordan, sachin. ETA: end of next sprint.

maria: Thanks all. Small note: when you open the PR, please include a synthetic test showing how a noisy-card vs trending-card changes autoscaler decisions (e.g., drain probability).

aj: Will do. Closing thread for now — ping here if anyone hits blockers. :thumbsup:
